_meta.purpose: Register of the official-site check run against every hotel link shipped in data/hotels.json. Each entry records the URL that was fetched, what the fetch actually returned, and the corrected URL where the original was wrong.
_meta.verification_note: Each row was opened in this session and the quoted page text was read. Where a page could not be opened, the row says so and no value was taken from it.
_meta.why_this_exists: Three hotel links in the shipped data pointed at domains that no longer belong to the hotel (one parked, one for sale) or at the wrong property code, so a reader following the 'official site' link would not have reached the hotel.

hotels.what_the_page_shows: Eurostars Wall Street, 4-star, Financial District, New York. Page publishes check-in 15:00, check-out 12:00, 56 rooms, buffet breakfast 07:00-10:30 weekdays.
hotels.note: The page served Spanish copy to this fetch (the brand's default locale), which is a user-experience issue, not a data error. The hotel identity is unambiguous.

hotels.what_the_page_shows: A Namecheap parked-domain page selling domain auctions. It is not the hotel.
hotels.room_evidence: The hotel's own Queen page describes 'a comfy queen bed', a 'NYC pre-war style bathroom', and lists the room as Queen Standard. The hotel describes itself as Small Luxury Hotels of the World, NoMad, 90 rooms.
hotels.search_evidence: The hotel's own contact address is 34 E 32nd St, New York, NY 10016 (matches data/hotels.json), phone 212.779.3432, and reservations@hgunyc.com — which is why hgunyc.com is the hotel's domain and hgunewyork.com is not.
hotels.note: This hotel is the cheapest queued server-verified room in the current data, so a broken source link here mattered most.

hotels.what_the_page_shows: Hyatt Place New York / Chelsea, 140 West 24th Street, New York, NY 10011, tel +1 929 430 2400, 510 rooms. That address is the one in data/hotels.json.
hotels.note: The shipped URL used property code 'nyczc' — the code Hyatt uses for a different Hyatt Place in Manhattan. Hyatt's own page for 140 W 24th St is 'lgazc'.

hotels.what_the_page_shows: citizenM New York Times Square, 218 West 50th Street, New York, NY 10019, tel +1 212-461 3638, check-in 14:00, check-out 11:00, pets not allowed. Room page lists '1 King' rooms and states every room has an XL king-size bed.
hotels.note: citizenM is now part of Marriott Bonvoy, and the shipped citizenM URL redirects to the brand page rather than the property. The Marriott property page for the same hotel is the page that publishes the room and check-in facts.

hotels.what_the_page_shows: Pestana CR7 Times Square, 338 W 39th Street. FAQ publishes: check-in from 16:00, check-out 11:00; resort fee US$26.14 + 14.75% tax per room per night; local tax US$3.50 per room per night. hotels.note: The tax and fee lines matter: the existing site text quoted a $26/night resort fee, while the hotel's own FAQ publishes $26.14 plus 14.75% tax plus a $3.50 local tax. Both are now recorded from the hotel's own page.

hotels.note: The shipped path '/arlo-midtown/' does not exist; the hotel's own section lives at /midtown/.
